name: studio
description: Host-native crew orchestrator for Codex and Claude Code subagents.

interface.shortDescription: Convene and manage role-based native subagents.
interface.longDescription: Studio selects the minimum useful crew, assigns work through the host's native subagent tools, relays messages, reuses the original agent for rework, and reports results. It does not ship an agent runtime, sandbox, auth layer, or execution platform.
defaultPrompt: Use $producer to turn the owner's mission into the smallest useful role-based crew.
Use the current host's native subagent tools; never launch a separate Codex or Claude runtime.
The producer assigns work, relays messages, tracks handles and results, and never authors the deliverable.
Send review findings and rework to the original agent handle when the role and task are unchanged.
Let task-worker own implementation execution, session-review own review workflow, task-github own GitHub delivery, and wiki-markdown own durable knowledge.
